description: Start uploading a WAV recording (kind "wav") or a packet capture (kind "pcap"). Returns an upload_id and a one-time upload_url; send the file as the body of an HTTP PUT to that URL (for example: curl -T recording.wav '<upload_url>'), then pass the upload_id to an analysis tool. The URL works once and expires after 15 minutes; the file is deleted after an hour. Use upload_inline instead if you can only pass tool arguments.

filename.description: original file name, for display only

size_bytes.description: file size, if known; larger than the limit is refused at once

name: create_upload

expires_at.description: the URL must be used before this time

upload_url.description: one-time URL: HTTP PUT the file as the request body

title: Create an upload URL
